# DOCXKIT_PREVIEW_INPUT_INVALID: Invalid preview input

The preview input is absent or not one of the supported input types.

## What to do

1. Pass a DOCX Blob, ArrayBuffer, Uint8Array, or URL.
2. Wait for generation to finish before starting preview.

## Problem example

```ts
// Invalid external input:
const input = null
```

## Corrected example

```ts
import { createDocx, createDocxPreview } from 'docx-kit'

const container = document.createElement('div')
document.body.append(container)

const preview = createDocxPreview(container)
try {
  await preview.render(await createDocx().p('Hello').toBlob())
} finally { preview.destroy() }
```

## Common causes

- Null input or an unsupported object/string type.

## Diagnostic fields

- `code`: `PREVIEW_INPUT_INVALID`
- `diagnosticCode`: `DOCXKIT_PREVIEW_INPUT_INVALID`
- `name`: `DocxKitError`
- `docs`: https://docx-kit.ntnyq.dev/errors/docxkit_preview_input_invalid/

### Example message

```text
Unsupported preview input type
```
